# driver

`driver` implements native gamepad decoding, polling, output encoding, PlayStation report handling, XInput support, and live driver-set reconciliation.

## Contents

### Core driver boundary

- [driver.hpp](./driver.hpp) exports `driver`, `max_reports_per_poll`, `driver::poll`, and `driver::submit` as the polymorphic per-device Strategy boundary.
- [set.hpp](./set.hpp) exports `set`, `entry`, `set::reconcile`, `set::for_each`, and `set::submit` for active driver ownership and routing.
- [set.cpp](./set.cpp) binds `family::xbox`, `family::dualshock4`, `family::dualsense`, and `family::dualsense_edge` to transport-specific drivers.

### Shared decoding and output

- [decode.hpp](./decode.hpp) exports `rd_u8`, `rd_le16`, `rd_le16s`, `rd_le32`, `crc32_le`, `verify_ps_crc32`, `ps_touch_point`, `decode_touch_point`, `apply_hat`, and `normalize_ps_stick`.
- [decode.cpp](./decode.cpp) implements PlayStation field extraction, CRC verification, touch decoding, hat mapping, and radial stick normalization.
- [output.hpp](./output.hpp) exports `rumble_request`, `light_bar_request`, `player_led_request`, `adaptive_trigger_request`, `trigger_effect`, and `output_request`.
- [output-report.hpp](./output-report.hpp) exports `encode_dualshock4_output`, `encode_dualsense_output`, and report-size constants.
- [output-report.cpp](./output-report.cpp) encodes validated USB/Bluetooth rumble, lighting, and LED reports with PlayStation CRC framing.

### PlayStation drivers

- [playstation.hpp](./playstation.hpp) exports `enable_extended_reports` and `minimal_bluetooth_report` for Bluetooth feature negotiation and minimal-report detection.
- [playstation.cpp](./playstation.cpp) performs DualSense/DualSense Edge serial, firmware, and calibration feature reads.
- [dualshock4.hpp](./dualshock4.hpp) exports `decode_dualshock4` and `dualshock4_driver`.
- [dualshock4.cpp](./dualshock4.cpp) decodes DualShock 4 USB/Bluetooth reports and submits rumble or light-bar output.
- [dualsense.hpp](./dualsense.hpp) exports `decode_dualsense` and `dualsense_driver`.
- [dualsense.cpp](./dualsense.cpp) decodes DualSense reports, drains HID input, validates CRCs, and submits supported output.
- [dualsense-edge.hpp](./dualsense-edge.hpp) exports `decode_dualsense_edge` and `dualsense_edge_driver`.
- [dualsense-edge.cpp](./dualsense-edge.cpp) enables DualSense Edge rear-button decoding through `decode_dualsense(..., true)` and `read_and_decode(..., true)`.

### Xbox driver

- [xinput.hpp](./xinput.hpp) exports `decode_xinput` and `xinput_driver`.
- [xinput.cpp](./xinput.cpp) decodes `XINPUT_GAMEPAD`, suppresses unchanged `XINPUT_STATE` packets, and submits `XINPUT_VIBRATION` rumble.

## Architecture / Data Flow

`set::reconcile` snapshots `registry`, opens HID resources through `transport::open`, invokes `set::bind`, and stores `entry::drv` with optional `entry::hid`.

`set::for_each` invokes `driver::poll`, where `xinput_driver`, `dualshock4_driver`, `dualsense_driver`, and `dualsense_edge_driver` transform native reports into `raw_sample` and `canonical_sample`.

`driver::submit` routes `output_request` variants to `xinput_driver::submit`, `dualshock4_driver::submit`, or `dualsense_driver::submit`, while `output-report.cpp` performs device-specific report encoding.

## Behavioral Contracts

- `max_reports_per_poll` equals `32`, bounding HID draining while retaining the newest valid sample.
- `crc32_le` uses reflected IEEE CRC-32 polynomial `0xEDB88320u`; `ps_input_crc_seed`, `ps_output_crc_seed`, and `ps_feature_crc_seed` equal `0xA1`, `0xA2`, and `0xA3`.
- `normalize_ps_stick` centers coordinates at `128`, scales by `127.0f`, inverts Y, clamps each component to `[-1,1]`, and radially clamps magnitude to `1.0f`.
- `apply_hat` maps values `0..7` clockwise from up to `button::dpad_*`; invalid values clear the dpad state.
- `dualshock4_driver` accepts USB report `0x01` with `64` bytes and Bluetooth report `0x11` with `78` bytes.
- `dualsense_driver` accepts USB report `0x01` with `64` bytes and Bluetooth report `0x31` with `78` bytes.
- `minimal_bluetooth_report` identifies Bluetooth reports whose byte `0` equals `ps_report_bt_minimal`.
- `encode_dualshock4_output` emits USB report `0x05` or Bluetooth report `0x11`; `encode_dualsense_output` emits USB or Bluetooth report `0x31`.
- `bt_output_sequence_` advances modulo `16` for DualSense Bluetooth output.
- `xinput_driver::poll` publishes only when `XINPUT_STATE::dwPacketNumber` changes.
- `driver::poll` and `driver::submit` are `noexcept`, non-allocating ABI operations; malformed or unsupported reports produce no guessed output.

## File Relationships

`decode_dualshock4` and `decode_dualsense` consume `decode.hpp` primitives, `playstation.hpp` CRC helpers, and `sample/sample.hpp` structures.

`dualshock4_driver` and `dualsense_driver` consume `transport/hid.hpp` for report I/O, while `xinput_driver` consumes `transport/xinput-module.hpp` for `XINPUT_STATE` and `XINPUT_VIBRATION`.

`dualsense_edge_driver` inherits `dualsense_driver`; `set::bind` selects `dualsense_edge_driver` for `family::dualsense_edge`.

`output-report.cpp` consumes `output_request`, `connection`, `crc32_le`, and report-size constants to implement `dualshock4_driver::submit` and `dualsense_driver::submit`.
